revision_note: Stacked on PR #151; exact changed-source and compiled test-binary hashes identify the qualified tree. Receipt and documentation refreshed after execution.

hardware.isolation: Disposable fixtures on a shared developer host; other workloads were present.

fixtures.scope: Synthetic loopback PostgreSQL -> encrypted retained broker -> S3-compatible fixture; no live provider.

transfer.scope: Run lookup, SQL read/serialization, encrypted staging, complete multipart sink write and independent full-object download/hash; excludes compile, fixture startup and Python row verification.

recovery.scope: Real SIGKILL at second multipart part, changed source-state row, broker lease fence, expired ordinary source retention; full S3 readback reconciles the prior matching destination, then confirmed repetition skips it. No new writer for an unresolved effect.

memory.scope: Sample sum includes /usr/bin/time parent, Go test harness, in-process broker and owned executor children. Excludes Docker services/daemon, OS cache, compilation and independent Python verifier. RSS sums may count shared pages per process; sampled peak is not a hard bound.

retained_storage.scope: At observed crash boundary: four full SQL inputs plus initial 9 MiB+17 S3 file. Relation includes indexes/TOAST and small fixture data; excludes WAL, backups, SQL temporary files and other relations. No continuous peak measurement of total database storage.

whole_rehearsal.scope: Direct test binary including fixture provisioning/cleanup, all source/sink failure cases, readbacks and deliberate lease waits; excludes compilation and Python verification.

failure_assertions.database_storage_error: PostgreSQL 53100 injected after two real retained chunks; nontransactional sequence proves the boundary fired. Host disk was not filled.
failure_assertions.backpressure: Second part held; no subsequent parts or completion while blocked.
failure_assertions.cancellation: Caller error, no open multipart uploads or active/pending execution requests; prior-good length and digest preserved. Separate single-slot SQL cancellation check passes.
failure_assertions.executor_loss: One orphan multipart upload with one 8 MiB part explicitly observed and aborted. Recovery confirms prior matching destination with complete readback, zero new parts/completions; confirmed repetition skips the effect.
failure_assertions.refusals: Expired/missing file association, mismatched metadata and cross-organization input rejected. Public JSON omits private IDs.
failure_assertions.cleanup: Ordinary maintenance query removes expired SQL retained streams after fixture advances stream/pin expiries. Package-owned Docker fixtures report successful cleanup.
failure_assertions.concurrent_pin_and_expiry: Real uncommitted pin held across expiry while maintenance waits; after commit, fresh-snapshot expiry preserves both the stream and its source request. The same fixture failed before the locking repair. REPEATABLE READ maintenance is refused.
failure_assertions.pre_dispatch_failure: Sink credential-decryption failure before provider dispatch, then changed SQL source and repaired synthetic credential; fresh sink claim reads the original retained bytes. Confirmed repetition sends no additional parts.
failure_assertions.retention_policy_changes: Ten-day-old checkpoint follows 30 -> 3 -> 30 day policy changes. Maintenance preserves bytes at 30 days; encrypted manifest/chunk reads succeed at 30 and fail at 3 days. Synthetic reader request is explicitly removed.

coderabbit.resolution: Procedure now propagates test, sampler and verifier failure statuses. Four shell exit-status checks passed.
coderabbit.prior_major_issue: Concurrent pin/expiry race reproduced, repaired with parent locking and a fresh-snapshot cutoff, then requalified.
coderabbit.scope: Prior full implementation review and fixes preceded this rebase; stacked integration review recorded separately.

stacked_review.resolution: Existing pins now derive their deadlines from current organization retention in one shared SQL view used by listing, reader functions and maintenance. Fresh policy increase/decrease and encrypted manifest/chunk read regression passed; complete large rehearsal rerun after repair.

independent_verification: Complete initial, byte-recovered and reconciled objects verified separately with sql-object-envelope and frozen datasets.sql formula; all three verdicts retained beside this receipt.

retained_byte_recovery.scope: Sink credential-decryption failure before provider dispatch, then changed SQL source and repaired synthetic credential; fresh sink claim reads the original retained bytes. Confirmed repetition sends no additional parts.

publication_rebase_scope: Dependency PR #151 merged during qualification. Current main differs from the tested dependency head only in README.md badges; runtime, schema, dependencies and test inputs are byte-identical. Rebased for publication without repeating unchanged runtime checks.
